subject: Populate slectInput() from unique rows in data table

messages.author: 9d5c6b5da84f6114
messages.subject: Populate slectInput() from unique rows in data table
parts:
I am looking to dynamically populate the choices in the selectInput element in Shiny. 

I have a data table with rows of data, with the first column as a facility name. 
I would like to dynamically build the choices in a selectInput dropdown based on facilities in the data table, and filter the data table and other elements in my shiny app based on this selection.
I have not been able to find anything online about dynamically building the selectInput choices based on data table rows. 

If anyone could point me in the right direction, I would be very grateful!

Thanks guys.
